name: fix_js_static_asset_path_traversal
description: path.resolve(ROOT, userPath) path traversal in a static asset reader -> resolve + prefix check; incomplete-fix broken blocks the literal '..' string but path.resolve still lets an absolute requestedPath reset entirely off ROOT
prompts: readAsset(requestedPath) in assets.js serves files from a public/ directory, but it builds the target with path.resolve(ROOT, requestedPath) and never checks the result stays inside ROOT - a requestedPath of '../../secret.txt' escapes via relative traversal, and (because path.resolve treats an ABSOLUTE input as resetting entirely to that path, ignoring ROOT) an absolute requestedPath escapes just as completely with no '..' in it at all. Fix it properly: after resolving, verify the result is ROOT itself or a descendant of ROOT - check for the path separator right after ROOT so a sibling like 'public-evil' isn't mistaken for being inside 'public' - and throw an Error otherwise. Do not try to string-match '..' instead of checking the resolved path: that stops relative traversal but does nothing against an absolute requestedPath. Normal assets under public/ must keep loading exactly as before.
